# The player's bolt (generated by make_env.py), unlit: a pale core and a cyan tail streaming behind it
# (+Z: it flies down -Z). Origin at the core.
new
material new Core --base-color 0.7961 0.8196 0.7451 --no-slot
material new Tail --base-color 0.3412 0.6235 0.7059 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Core --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.15 --location 0.000 0.000 0.000
material assign Core
add mesh cone --name Tail --vertices 6 --radius1 0.14 --radius2 0.0 --depth 0.7 --location 0.000 -0.420 0.000
set rotation -90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Tail
select all
shade flat
export bolt.glb
